textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 maths · Finding the Unknown · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Solve 5x - 4 = 7. To keep only 5x on the left, remove the - 4 by adding 4 to both sides: 5x = 11. To keep only x, divide both sides by 5: x = 11/5. Check by substituting: 5 × 11/5 - 4 = 11 - 4 = 7.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Finding the Unknown: Solve 5x - 4 = 7. To keep only 5x on the left, remove the - 4 by adding 4 to both sides: 5x = 11. To keep only x, divide both sides by 5: x = 11/5. Check by substituting: 5 × 11/5 - 4 = 11 - 4 = 7.
beats.speakEn: Let us review the key takeaway from Finding the Unknown: Solve 5x - 4  equals  7. To keep only 5x on the left, remove the - 4 by adding 4 to both sides: 5x  equals  11. To keep only x, divide both sides by 5: x  equals  11/5. Check by substituting: 5  times  11/5 - 4  equals  11 - 4  equals  7.
